Proposal v3 · 5-Cut Diffusion

Samsung Bespoke AI Fridge
— Offline Visit Diffusion

"What if you could feel the AI without owning it?"

Bespoke AI Family Hub · Mega Stitch → Reaction → 3 Visit Angles

Block 1 · Creative Intent

Why Offline Visits, Not Product Seeding

Refrigerators can't be shipped to nano creators the way skincare or small appliances can. So instead of seeding the product, we seed the experience — guiding creators to a Samsung offline showroom and letting them film honest, in-the-moment reactions to the AI features.

Tech mega/macro creators already get the seeded fridge and produce tutorial-style demos. Nano creators don't get the unit — but they can visit, react, and stitch the macro's tutorial themselves. That's the diffusion play.

The goal isn't a polished spec demo. It's the moment a friend turns to camera and says "wait this thing actually knows what's inside?" — that's the cognition that scales.

Core USPs This Catalog Targets

01
AI Vision Inside
The fridge knows what's inside without opening the door. Internal cam + AI recognition on the Family Hub LCD.
02
AI Recipe Recommendation
"Don't know what to cook?" — the fridge suggests recipes from what's actually inside.
03
SmartThings & Auto-Reorder
Stock notices + grocery reorder + dashboard alerts — all tied into SmartThings.

5-Cut Flow · How One Nano Video Is Structured

1
CUT 1 · Hero Stitch Source (Mega/Macro Seeded Demo)
Open with a clip of a mega/macro creator's seeded fridge tutorial — the "real" demo that lands the USP context. This is what the nano stitches off of.
2
CUT 2 · Stitch Reaction ("oh that's so cool, I wanna see it")
Nano's face reacting to the mega's demo — explains what a stitch is for viewers who don't know the format. Drives the visit.
3
CUT 3 · Visit Angle 01 · AI Vision Inside
"Yo bro… you know what's in that fridge? I do."
4
CUT 4 · Visit Angle 02 · AI Recipe Recommendation
"Don't know what to cook? Samsung showroom it is."
5
CUT 5 · Visit Angle 03 · Auto-Reorder
"Stop crying about chicken breast. Just buy this."
Block 2 · Cut-by-Cut Guideline
Cut 1 · Hero Stitch Source
Scene
Mega creator demo opens the clip — sets up "this is what Samsung Bespoke AI does."
On-Screen Line
(mega creator's original VO) — "okay so this fridge literally knows what's inside…"
Direction
Pull a 2–3s clip from a mega/macro seeded creator — preferably the moment they're showing the AI feature ON SCREEN (e.g. @triggtube tapping through the recipe on the 9", or @joslynkramer pointing at the Vision Inside UI). This frames the "real" product before the nano reacts. Keep audio — the mega's voice doing the explanation is what carries the proof.
Visual ref: @triggtube · sec ~22 (SmartThings recipe close-up)
Cut 2 · Stitch Reaction
Scene
Nano's face reacting — "okay wait. I have to see this in person."
On-Screen Line
"wait wait wait — they really do that?? I'm going to the showroom RIGHT now."
Direction
Channel the lively reaction energy of K-beauty TikTok creators watching a product clip — head-on talking head, genuine surprise, slight smile, gestures responding to what's on screen. The takeaway feeling: "I just watched this — I have to go see it for myself."
Caption
no way that's real?? 👀 we have to go check
Visual ref: @juhyegotchi · sec 0 (reaction opening shot)
Cut 3 · Visit · AI Vision Inside
Scene
"Bet you can't tell me what's in that fridge."
On-Screen Line
"yo. you know what's in there? I do. without opening it. watch."
USP Tied
AI Vision Inside
Caption
yo. you know what's in there? I do. without opening it. watch.
Visual ref: Samsung visit · AI Vision Inside UI w/ visitor reaction
Cut 4 · Visit · AI Recipe
Scene
"Don't know what to cook tonight? Samsung showroom it is."
On-Screen Line
"Don't know what to cook tonight? Don't worry. It just told me."
USP Tied
AI Recipe Recommendation

don't know what to cook tonight? it just told me.

Cut 5 · Visit · Auto-Reorder

"Stop crying about running out. Just buy this."

"never worry about running out of ingredients again — one tap right from here and it's on the way."
